sections.title: Naming your equipment
sections.content: fazék ("pot") and serpenyő ("frying pan") are where the cooking actually happens — you'll mostly meet them with -ban/-ben ("in the pot"), which you already know from A1. kanál, kés and villa are what you hold, so they're the ones that naturally take -val/-vel.

items.english: There are a lot of ingredients in the pot.
There are a lot of vegetables in the pan.

items.spanish: Nem csak kanállal, hanem villával is eszem.
items.english: I eat not only with a spoon, but also with a fork.

sections.content: nem csak... hanem... is from Unit 5 chains naturally with -val/-vel — a good reminder that this unit's new grammar builds on Units 1-5, not just replaces them.
